full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white pen illustration presents an extreme close-up of an older man's face, caricatured with oversized round glasses, a broad nose, and an immense curled mustache and beard. The head fills nearly the entire left and central frame, turned slightly upward toward the right. A soft cap presses low over the forehead, its brim defined by dense curved hatching. His eyes look upward through the thick circular lenses, one eye magnified by the drawing's distorted perspective. The nose pushes forward almost as strongly as the glasses, while wild mustache tips sweep outward over the cheeks. The beard flows down to the lower edge in hundreds of fine parallel and crossing lines, leaving only small pale breaks where light touches the hair. Wrinkles crease the forehead, eye corners, and cheek, each exaggerated yet carefully described. Behind the head at the upper right, leafy branches form a dark stippled canopy; a small pale building facade peeks through at the lower right. The background remains secondary and lightly sketched, so the dense face feels even closer. Crosshatching and tiny dots create the middle grays, with no smooth painted fills. Light appears to come broadly from the upper right, leaving white highlights on the lenses, nose, and beard while under the cap and within the facial creases the ink packs into dark shadow. The overall composition makes personality out of intense line density, comic distortion, and a boldly cropped face.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形黑白钢笔插图呈现一张老年男子的极近距离面孔，以夸张的巨大圆眼镜、宽鼻子和极丰厚卷曲的胡须构成漫画式形象。头部几乎填满左侧和中央画面，略向右上方转。软便帽低低压在额前，帽檐由密集弯曲排线界定。他透过厚圆镜片向上看，绘画的变形透视让一只眼睛显得放大。鼻子几乎同眼镜一样向前突出，飞扬的胡须尖端扫过脸颊。长须以数百道细密平行和交错线条流向下缘，只有受光发丝上留有少量浅色断点。皱纹刻在额头、眼角和脸颊，每一处夸张却描绘仔细。头后右上方，叶枝形成深色点描树冠；右下方露出一小块浅色建筑立面。背景保持次要且草绘简略，使密集的面孔显得更加贴近。交叉排线和细小点纹产生中灰，没有平滑涂色面。光似从右上方宽泛进入，在镜片、鼻子和胡须上留下白色高光，帽下与面部皱褶里墨线则挤成深影。整体构图从极高线条密度、喜剧化变形和大胆裁切的面孔中塑造个性。
style_prompt_en: The image has a black-and-white pen-and-ink caricature finish, with dense crosshatching, stippling, and finely controlled line weight. White paper carries the highlights while repeated black strokes accumulate into soft gray and deep shadow. Focal forms are exaggerated in scale and tightly cropped, but tiny anatomical and material marks remain precise. Curved contour lines and radiating hatching make rounded volumes feel tactile. A densely worked foreground contrasts with a much lighter, sketchier periphery. Broad daylight is suggested by untouched white passages rather than painted glow; dark undercuts provide the counterweight. The overall effect is comic, vigorous, and obsessively detailed.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有黑白钢笔漫画质感，运用密集交叉排线、点描和受控的细致线条粗细。白纸承担高光，重复黑笔画累积成柔灰与深影。焦点形态在尺度上夸张并被贴近裁切，但细小结构和材料标记仍精确。弯曲轮廓线与放射状排线使圆润体积可触。加工繁密的前景与更浅、更草绘的外围对比。宽泛日光由未着墨的白色通道暗示，而非绘制发光；深色内凹区域提供平衡。整体效果诙谐、有力且细节极密。
theme_en: A comically exaggerated old man with round glasses and a cap
theme_zh: 戴圆眼镜与便帽的夸张老年男子
name: Robert Crumb
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
